tools.name: search_regulatory_changes
tools.description: Use when you need what financial regulators in Canada, the US, the UK or the EU have published on a topic or in a date range. Returns matching records newest first, each with its link and id. Free for 50 calls per caller each UTC day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: recent_regulatory_changes
tools.description: Use when you need what is new from financial regulators rather than a specific topic. Lists the latest publications across every covered regulator, newest first, optionally for one jurisdiction. Free for 50 calls per caller each UTC day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: get_regulatory_change
tools.description: Use when you have a record id and need to know whether the publication was amended and what changed. Returns the record in full with every revision observed since first collection. Free for 50 calls per caller each UTC day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: Use when you need to know which regulators and feeds are monitored, and how fresh each is, before reading an absence of results as an absence of publications. Lists every feed with when it was last collected. Always free.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_regulatory_changes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
